sources_checked: UCL Collections Online (zoology database) web search + Axiell WebAPI https://collections.ucl.ac.uk/AxiellWebApi/wwwopac.ashx?database=zoology
queries: crocodile (53 hits); mummy (0); mummified (2); Egypt (1); API description=crocodil* (6)
result_detail: 53 crocodilian specimens (skeletons, fluid, skins, fossils, taxidermy, leather goods). Only 'mummified' crocodile is LDUCZ-X446 'Skull of the Australian saltwater crocodile which is covered with mummified skin' (Crocodylus porosus) - not Egyptian. No Egyptian crocodile mummy found.
notes: Many Crocodylidae skeletons lack provenance in brief records; an ancient Egyptian specimen catalogued only as 'skeleton' cannot be excluded.
